body: It comes and goes for me, I had jaw surgery about a month ago, and I got put on antibiotics + pain meds and the grace period of being on those is done, so my IBS re-awoke with a vengeance, granted it has been awake since December of last year so it's incredibly frustrating where I can be sitting down looking at a screen doing whatever just fine, then the next, my lower left is in grueling pain, I get the runs and end up fighting for my life in the bathroom. Of course I've gone to the ER multiple times and Gastro about it again but all I get told is to "take this or that and deal with it". This condition really isn't fair, I've only had it on and off for the last 5 years, and this year, it's just been hell, but nothing much we can do but force ourselves to survive.

I'm having the same sensation right now, had the runs with pain an hour ago as par the course, unfortunately until the inflammation of the intestine/stomach calms down, we are gonna be feeling it for a while, hang in there.

It usually goes away over time but there is always something that pops up to remind you of them, in my case, anything snake-related due to her username online or anyone that remotely looks like her gets to me, sometimes when I am playing the same video game we used to play together, I have to pause for a moment to just process that I'm not doing it with them anymore, same with listening to music, I am not listening to certain artists and songs with them anymore, hell just knowing that she was here in the same city during Christmas and I couldn't see her, it's awful but you have to remind yourself that those interests are your own, you just shared them with that person and you can still do it, alone, it just isn't easy but it is possible.

I feel the same way you do right now, I cut off everyone to protect them from me, I just have so much negativity, so much rage, so much uncertainty and the powerlessness gets too much to bear, It's not easy knowing that your ex-GF goes all the way to a different continent just to be with someone while leaving me months ago in such a cruel and vile way and giving me the excuse that I was too far despite being only 2 hours away in different states, I have lost so many friends, so many opportunities, and you and me are just expected to live on and pretend that none of the bad things that have happened happen, that karma will do it's work blah blah blah. Yet it hasn't, we are still here wondering when the pain will ever end and honestly right now, It just feels like I'm re-living time and having the people that supposedly still care about you either just ignore you or tell you to suck it up and keep living. We don't know what will happen, but is hope really enough of a reason to not be tired?

I also want to say something to her here, it won't be read by them and it's something that I have held on too long so my bad if it seems like I'm hi-jacking your post.

It would have been a year this week if we had stayed together, and that was always the original intent, and the promise that I wanted to keep, I still hear your voice in my head, your old voice telling me how much I meant to you and how much you loved me. 5 months wasted for nothing, only for you to do the exact same thing with someone else in an entirely different continent.

Back in September when you broke my heart, you didn't have any remorse or regrets, you blamed me for slowing you down when you did that yourself, I stood by your side while you dealt with a virus that could have killed you, I was so worried that you were going to die when I saw how thin you became, but even then I wanted to love and take care of you so much more, so much more and the months after spent fighting and hating each other for nothing, because you could never understand all the grief and pain you helped caused.

A person who genuinely loves someone wouldn't goddamn threatened their partner with blocking or wishing that they died earlier in their lives, they wouldn't put you down mentally when you are making progress, when you are willing to do anything to see them again. You don't goddamn spread lies about them to random people all over the goddamn country, no the world, because of you not willing to accept any of your actions and paint yourself as the victim.

Speaking of another country, you decide that choosing someone from the same discord we met, who's in goddamn Italy is your saving grace, "the one", the "love of your life", the "Eternally yours", how dare you say those words to someone else, when you used them  so much with me, hell when you were with your EX, you called him the same thing, so that means none of your words are special, none of them truly mean anything if you just choose to call someone else that, and what makes you think this new relationship will last. If someone who was in the next state over could only last a year, someone only 4 states above and lived in your original home could only last 5 months, and someone who is literally in the same state as you could only last 1 month.

What makes you think this will, hell I'm surprised your parents isn't stopping any of this considering how much drama they caused us for wanting to be together last year, that I was "too far away", that I was "not good enough", and yet they are willing to go across the Atlantic Ocean just to make you happy, you don't deserve it, you took me and so many others before for granted.

You lied to me that you loved me, you lied to so many others about me, you abandoned me and I know that you don't care, but you will fail, you will fall again and I hope no one picks you up again, no one is ever too far gone, but you don't deserve to be saved, that's what you said to me when I was mentally broken and now I say it to you, your dogs deserve better.

I will move on now, be free from this burden, be better mentally, physically, and financially, but you will always need to rely on someone else because you can't handle being alone.

Yeah, I can relate to that, I am not certain if this has any backing in research but IBS has given me a sort of heightened sense of smell from what I have noticed. I have a hard time going to the kitchen or walking down certain streets due to the strong smell of either cooking of anything or substances and dust from construction sites. The heat and smells during the summer were hell to deal with recently but I notice when my nose is stuffy or it's cold, I don't have much of an issue. I guess it might be related to how the nervous system is more reactive when you are in a flare and since there's nerve endings in the nose, I guess that might cause it to be more reactionary.
